title: Identification of hub biomarkers of myocardial infarction by single-cell sequencing, bioinformatics, and machine learning.
summary: LASSO and SVM-RFE selected MI biomarkers from GEO expression data; IL1B/TLR2 and combined signature discriminated MI from controls and were checked in three independent GEO datasets. Full-text Methods and Results were checked; the AI operation, first result-bearing version, measured result and validation are confirmed, with no catalog or lane duplicate.
